reports.title: Top domains
reports.summary: Most frequently queried domains in the window, with how many distinct clients asked for each.

reports.title: Query volume by day
reports.summary: Daily query counts with cache-hit and blocklist-match shares, for spotting trends and outages.

reports.title: Query volume by hour of day
reports.summary: Average queries per hour-of-day across the window, showing when the network is busiest.

reports.title: Query types
reports.summary: Breakdown by DNS record type (A, AAAA, HTTPS, PTR and the rest), resolved through DimType.

reports.title: Status breakdown
reports.summary: How queries were answered - forwarded, served from cache, or matched against a blocklist.

reports.title: Top clients
reports.summary: Busiest clients resolved to host name, MAC and vendor, with their distinct-domain footprint.

reports.title: Single client detail
reports.summary: Every domain one client asked for in the window, ranked by volume.

reports.title: Newly seen domains
reports.summary: Domains whose very first appearance anywhere in the warehouse falls inside the window - useful for spotting new services or beaconing.

reports.title: Would-be-blocked domains
reports.summary: Queries that were answered normally but whose domain sits on a blocklist. This is the report that matters while Pi-hole blocking is switched off.

reports.title: Blocklist effectiveness
reports.summary: Which subscribed blocklist would have caught the most traffic, and how many of its domains were ever actually queried.

reports.title: Would-be-blocked by client
reports.summary: Which devices generate the most blocklist-matching traffic, as a share of everything they ask for.

reports.title: Upstream resolvers
reports.summary: Where forwarded queries went, with reply-time percentiles per upstream.

reports.title: Slowest domains
reports.summary: Domains with the worst average upstream reply time, restricted to those queried often enough to be meaningful.

reports.title: Malformed domain names
reports.summary: Rows whose domain is not a valid host name - non-UTF-8 bytes substituted at load time, embedded ports, or stray labels. A data-quality and client-misbehaviour check.

reports.title: Ingest freshness
reports.summary: How current the warehouse is, and whether the streaming loader has left any gaps in the last few days.
